_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled inside Complacency with flat funding and diverging heat factors; statistically honest call is HOLD until a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both non-bullish, but analyst explicit HOLD/coil vs narrative mild distribution lean; no shared directional break call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds range, F&G stays 47-54, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: vol expansion breaks price and F&G <47 into Anxiety, or momentum/funding reheat lifts score into Disbelief
